name: Dreadsteed of Xoroth
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 6,600 experience instead of 7,050, 0.94 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
All the preparations are made.  Now, you must perform the ritual to create a Circle of Greater Summoning, then use the parchment infused with Xorothian stardust... to open a portal to Xoroth.

I have written the instructions for the ritual onto a scroll.  Study it closely, for you must perform each step exactly if you wish to succeed.

Fortune to you, adventurer.  And may the souls of your enemies swiftly find their way into your shard pouch.
narrative.objectives: Read Mor'zul's Instructions.  Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.
narrative.offerRewardText: The Xorothian Dreadsteed's spirit is beaten.  Although rage pulses through its ghostly flanks, you know that the beast's soul is yours...It whispers dark magic into your mind and instills within you the knowledge to summon a dreadsteed.

chain.subtitle: 12 quests from level 58 to 60, 56,875 XP in all.

quests.name: Mor'zul Bloodbringer
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Lord Banehollow
quests.objectiveText: Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes. Use the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.

quests.name: Rage of Blood
quests.objectiveText: Bring 30 bottles of Raging Beast's Blood to Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Ulathek the Traitor
quests.objectiveText: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.

quests.name: Wildeyes
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Case of Blood to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Imp Delivery
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance.

quests.name: Arcanite
quests.objectiveText: Bring 3 Arcanite Bar to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.
